about.label: About and help
about.tagline: A dice cup in your phone: shake it, hear the dice rattle, lay it down and read the roll.
about.intro: Pocket Dice Cup turns your phone into a dice cup for board games, tabletop RPGs and dice games. The dice are real 3D physics inside the phone: they rattle against the screen’s edges as you shake it, with a clack and a tap of vibration on every hit, and come to rest when you lay it down. The result is read from the faces the dice land on, never from a random number.

shake.title: Shake to roll
shake.body: Hold the phone like a dice cup and shake it. The dice tumble the way the phone moves, so a hard shake rolls them hard and a gentle one barely turns them. Then lay the phone flat on the table, screen up, and the total shows once the dice stop.

settle.title: Settle
settle.body: A phone held in the hand is never quite flat or still, so the dice slide into its lowest edge. While a roll is under way, Settle lets them drop as if the phone lay flat on the table, and the button spins until the roll ends with a result.

tap.title: Tap, click or press space
tap.body: On a computer, or where the browser has no motion sensor or motion access was refused, tap the table, click it or press the space bar to throw the dice. A tap is also a quick way to roll again on the phone; with the phone in the hand, the dice then drop as if Settle were pressed.

dice.title: Choose your dice
dice.body: The dice button shows what is in the cup, such as 3d6 or 2d6 + d20. Tap it to add or take out dice: up to {dice} at once, mixing d4, d6, d8, d10, d12 and d20. The result card shows the total and each die’s value.

rolledOver.title: Dice that did not roll over
rolledOver.body: A gentle shake can slide a die about on one face without turning it, as in a real cup. A faint ring on the table marks each die that ended on the face it started with; shake harder for a fair roll.

history.title: History
history.body: History keeps your last {history} rolls, with each die and the time, on this device. Clear removes them.

style.title: Style
style.body: Style changes the dice’s finish, in glossy resin, clear tinted resin or metal, and the table they land on, felt or a battle mat. The dice roll the same in every finish and on every table.

feel.title: Sound and vibration
feel.body: Each hit plays a clack, louder for a harder hit, once you have tapped the screen. The phone also taps with each hit in the iPhone and Android apps and in Android browsers; iPhone browsers cannot vibrate. The iPhone’s silent switch mutes the sound, as it does in games.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Everything runs on your device. The motion sensor’s readings, your dice and your history stay on it, and there are no accounts, ads or tracking.
